title: Safety Side Effects of Preventative Persona Steering: An Empirical Audit
abstract: arXiv:2611.17620v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High-level behaviors such as sycophancy and hallucination correspond to directions in a model's activation space (Chen et al., 2025). These directions, known as persona vectors, can suppress undesirable traits either at inference time, subtracting the vector during generation, or through preventative steering, adding the vector during fine-tuning, so the optimizer never needs to encode the trait in weights, then removing the vector at evaluation. Chen et al. (2025) recommend preventative steering because it preserves Massive Multitask Language Understanding (MMLU) accuracy, but validations of this recommendation have measured capability alone. translated_title: 预防性人格引导的安全副作用：一项实证审计
translated_abstract: 谄媚和幻觉等高层次行为对应于模型激活空间中的特定方向（Chen等人，2025）。这些方向被称为人格向量，可以通过两种方式抑制不良特质：一是在推理时干预，在生成过程中减去该向量；二是通过预防性引导，在微调过程中添加该向量，使优化器无需在权重中编码该特质，然后在评估时移除该向量。Chen等人（2025）推荐使用预防性引导，因为它能保持大规模多任务语言理解基准的准确率，但对这一建议的验证仅测量了能力方面。我们主要评估了在三个模型上对谄媚和幻觉向量进行预防性引导的结果，测量了三个安全基准以及特质表达、连贯性和MMLU。我们的发现表明，预防性引导仍然会改变模型的拒绝行为，但变化的程度取决于（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该实证审计发现，预防性人格向量引导虽然能保持MMLU能力，但仍然会改变模型的拒绝行为等安全特性，揭示了以往仅基于能力评估的验证所忽略的安全副作用。
en_tdlr: This empirical audit reveals that preventative persona steering, despite preserving MMLU capability, still alters models' refusal behavior, exposing safety side effects that prior capability-only validations failed to detect.
